text:
pablo: Heads-up everyone — we just published the Community Plugin Incubator v0.1.0. Its a tiny scaffold + examples for building Redwood plugins. Release notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/plugin-incubator/releases/tag/v0.1.0 :tada:
faye: awesome! whats included in the scaffold?
pablo: basic plugin manifest, CI action template, a local dev server for testing plugins, and two example plugins (formatting and a simple metrics exporter).
cli-bot: cli-bot: release pipeline green for tag v0.1.0 (build 77) :white_check_mark:
sasha: install instructions?
pablo: clone and run the make targets. quick: `git clone ... && make install-dev` or use `npm init @redwood/plugin` to bootstrap.
growth: can we get a one-liner for socials?
faye: "Community Plugin Incubator v0.1.0  starter scaffold, CI templates, and example plugins to help maintainers ship integrations faster."
sasha: any breaking changes or dangerous defaults?
pablo: defaults conservative: plugins run sandboxed locally and the CI template uses a read-only token placeholder. CI and publish steps are opt-in.
cli-bot: docs-builder: docs preview built for branch release/plugin-incubator :rocket:
growth: I'll schedule a short post to community channels. tagging faye as point contact for the next 48h and pablo for escalations.
faye: I'll monitor GH discussions and shepherd any quick PRs.
pablo: thanks all  please report any install issues here. closing thread unless we get reports. :wave:
